steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and cube sweet potato, then steam for 12 minutes until completely tender.
Mash the cooked sweet potato in a large bowl until smooth with no lumps.
Add coconut milk and olive oil to the mashed sweet potato and stir to combine.
Stir in rice flour, cinnamon, and baking powder until a soft, pliable dough forms.
Divide dough into 2 balls; press each into a thin round, about 5 mm thick, on the prepared sheet.
Bake for 14 to 16 minutes, until the edges are golden and the surface feels dry.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then cut each round into 8 triangles.
Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
